articles.fullText:
Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi, also a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, meets with Israeli President Isaac Herzog on the sidelines of the Seventh Summit of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence Building Measures in Asia (CICA) in Baku, Azerbaijan, October 15, 2026. /Xinhua
Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi met with Israeli President Isaac Herzog at the latter's request on the sidelines of the Seventh Summit of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence Building Measures in Asia in Baku, Azerbaijan, on Thursday.
Herzog said the Jewish and Chinese peoples have a long history of exchanges. The two peoples helped each other during the World Anti-Fascist War, forging a friendship that has become a memorable chapter in history.
Israel firmly adheres to the one-China policy and is committed to advancing friendly relations with China, he said. Israel is willing to take the 35th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries next year as an opportunity to expand exchanges and cooperation in areas such as science and technology, investment and people-to-people exchanges, he added.
Herzog briefed Wang on Israel's views and position on the situation in the Middle East, saying that Israel seeks peace, not war, but faces threats and challenges to its national security that require a strong response.
China has always been an important constructive force in promoting peace in the world and the region, Herzog said. Israel attaches importance to the relevant initiatives and proposals put forward by China, appreciates China's efforts to promote regional peace and stability, and stands ready to maintain communication with China, he added.
Wang, also a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, said that during World War II, both the Chinese and Israeli peoples suffered greatly from the ravages of war and extended a helping hand to each other in times of hardship, giving rise to many moving stories.
Since the establishment of diplomatic relations more than 30 years ago, bilateral relations have developed steadily, and practical cooperation has yielded positive results, Wang said, adding that the key lies in upholding mutual respect, treating each other as equals and pursuing mutually beneficial cooperation.
Next year will mark the 35th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and Israel and the 10th anniversary of the establishment of their innovative comprehensive partnership, he noted. China stands ready to work with Israel to take the anniversaries as an opportunity to review experience, advance cooperation and consolidate the foundation of public support for bilateral relations, Wang said.
Wang said promoting peace and reconciliation in the region is the cornerstone of China's Middle East policy. China has consistently maintained that the Palestinian question is the greatest historical injustice of this century and that the two-state solution is the right way to resolve the question.
The situation in the region remains tense, while peace and tranquility are still a long way to go, Wang said, adding that the top priority at present is to open full access to the Gaza Strip. The 2 million civilians there must not be left struggling on the brink of survival, nor should the humanitarian catastrophe be allowed to continue spreading; Israel should halt and reverse the forced establishment of settlements in the West Bank, he added.
Wang stressed that since the beginning of this year, President Xi Jinping has put forward a series of initiatives and proposals to promote peace and security in the Middle East, which are public goods that China has provided to the Middle East and the world.
China stands ready to work with the international community to uphold and practice the vision of common, comprehensive, cooperative and sustainable security; encourage all parties to return to the track of dialogue and consultation as soon as possible; and seek political solutions to conflicts, Wang said.
Wang said Herzog's father, former Israeli President Chaim Herzog, promoted the establishment of diplomatic ties between China and Israel during his presidency and was the first Israeli president to visit China.
The elder Herzog wrote in his memoir that compromises and negotiations do not always result in losing something but often bring about important gains and long-term trust. These words remain relevant and instructive under the current circumstances, Wang said.
The Palestinian question is the root cause of the Middle East issue, Wang noted, adding that both the Jewish and Palestinian peoples have the right to live in peace and establish independent states.
China believes that as long as all parties remain committed to and maintain their resolve to pursue peace, seek a path to peace by moving toward each other, and stay on the right course of the two-state solution, the peace that people have long yearned for will eventually come, Wang said.

2026年10月15日，在阿塞拜疆巴库举行的亚洲相互协作与信任措施会议第七次峰会期间，中国外交部长、中共中央政治局委员王毅会见以色列总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格。/新华社

周四，在阿塞拜疆巴库举行的亚洲相互协作与信任措施会议第七次峰会期间，中国外交部长王毅应以色列总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格的请求与其会面。赫尔佐格表示，犹太民族和中华民族有着悠久的交往历史。两国人民在世界反法西斯战争中相互帮助，结下了友谊，成为历史上令人难忘的篇章。他说，以色列坚定奉行一个中国政策，致力于推进对华友好关系。他补充说，以色列愿以明年两国建交35周年为契机，拓展在科技、投资和人文交流等领域的交流与合作。

赫尔佐格向王毅介绍了以色列对中东局势的看法和立场，称以色列寻求和平而非战争，但面临需要强有力回应的国家安全威胁和挑战。赫尔佐格说，中国始终是促进世界和地区和平的重要建设性力量。他补充说，以色列重视中国提出的相关倡议和建议，赞赏中国为促进地区和平与稳定所作的努力，并愿同中国保持沟通。王毅（也是中共中央政治局委员）表示，二战期间，中国和以色列两国人民都深受战争蹂躏之苦，在艰难时刻相互伸出援手，涌现出许多感人故事。王毅说，建交30多年来，双边关系稳步发展，务实合作取得积极成果，关键在于坚持相互尊重、平等相待、互利合作。他指出，明年将迎来中以建交35周年和两国创新全面伙伴关系建立10周年。

王毅表示，中方愿同以方一道，以建交周年为契机，总结经验、推进合作，夯实双边关系的民意基础。王毅说，促进地区和平与和解是中国中东政策的基石。中国一贯主张，巴勒斯坦问题是本世纪最大的历史不公，两国方案是解决该问题的正确途径。王毅说，地区局势依然紧张，和平与安宁仍任重道远，当前首要任务是全面开放加沙地带通道。那里的200万平民不能挣扎在生存边缘，人道主义灾难也不能继续蔓延；他补充说，以色列应停止并扭转在西岸强行建立定居点的做法。王毅强调，今年以来，习近平主席提出了一系列促进中东和平与安全的倡议和主张，这是中国为中东和世界提供的公共产品。

王毅说，中方愿同国际社会一道，坚持和践行共同、综合、合作、可持续的安全观，推动各方尽快回到对话协商的轨道上来，寻求政治解决冲突。王毅说，赫尔佐格的父亲、以色列前总统哈伊姆·赫尔佐格在任期间推动了中以建交，是首位访华的以色列总统。老赫尔佐格在回忆录中写道，妥协和谈判并不总是意味着失去什么，反而常常带来重要收获和长期信任。王毅说，这些话在当前形势下仍然具有现实意义和指导意义。王毅指出，巴勒斯坦问题是中东问题的根源，并补充说，犹太民族和巴勒斯坦民族都有权在和平中生活并建立独立国家。王毅说，中方相信，只要各方坚持并保持追求和平的决心，相向而行寻求和平之路，坚持两国方案的正确方向，人民期盼已久的和平终将到来。

articles.title: Painted in autumn: Echoes of Tang poetry along Beijing's Liangma River
articles.titleCn: 秋日画卷：北京亮马河畔的唐诗回响
articles.summary: As autumn settles over Beijing, this next article under "China, Soft Focus" series explores the season through the eyes of Tang Dynasty poets and their timeless verses. From the soft autumn light of daytime to the illuminated waterfront at night, the story captures two sides of Beijing's autumn landscape.
articles.summaryCn: 文章通过北京亮马河畔的秋景，串联起唐诗中对秋天的描绘，展现秋日天空与水光交融的短暂之美。

paragraphs.en: After Beijing's long, humid summer, autumn arrives almost {{0}} at first. The air loses some of its weight, the sky opens into clearer blue, and the {{1}} brightness of summer gives way to a softer, more {{2}} light. Along the city's avenues and parks, the first yellow leaves begin to appear among the {{3}}, while the cooler days invite people to {{4}} the outdoors – to walk a little farther, sit a little longer and notice the small changes that {{5}} the new season. For centuries, Chinese poets have found something particular in this transition. "自古逢秋悲寂寥，我言秋日胜春朝" – "Since ancient times, people have {{6}} autumn's loneliness; I say autumn is better than springtime," wrote Tang Dynasty (AD 618 to 907) poet Liu Yuxi.
paragraphs.cn: 北京漫长潮湿的夏天过后，秋天最初几乎悄无声息地到来。空气不再那么沉重，天空展开为更清澈的蓝色，夏日刺眼的光线让位于更柔和、更透明的光。在城市的大道和公园里，翠绿中开始出现最初的黄叶，而更凉爽的日子邀请人们重新回到户外——多走一段路，多坐一会儿，留意预示着新季节到来的细微变化。几个世纪以来，中国诗人在这转换中发现了某种特别的东西。“自古逢秋悲寂寥，我言秋日胜春朝”——唐代（公元618年至907年）诗人刘禹锡写道。

paragraphs.en: His words offer a different way of looking at the season – as a time of {{7}} and renewed life instead of an ending. And perhaps nowhere in the city is that feeling more easily found than beside its waterways. Along the Liangma River, autumn seems to gather in the afternoon light. Here, sunlight {{8}} across the {{9}}, sometimes bright and silver, sometimes softened by the {{10}} of leaves and sky. The river catches the sky while the yellow-clad willows write their {{11}} reflections across its surface, and a passing breeze is enough to turn a still image into motion.
paragraphs.cn: 他的话提供了一种看待这个季节的不同方式——将其视为清晰和重获新生的时刻，而非终结。也许在城市中，没有哪里比水边更容易找到这种感觉。沿着亮马河，秋天似乎聚集在午后的光线中。在这里，阳光散落在涟漪上，时而明亮如银，时而被树叶和天空的倒影柔化。河水映照天空，披着黄衣的柳树在水面写下变幻的倒影，一阵微风就足以将静止的画面变为动态。

paragraphs.en: As I walk along the riverbank, I cant help but recall another famous Tang Dynasty line, from Wang Bo's Preface to the Pavilion of King Teng: "落霞与孤鹜齐飞，秋水共长天一色" – "The sunset glow flies alongside the {{12}} wild duck; the autumn waters {{13}} with the vast sky into one color." Centuries and thousands of kilometers away, the image this poem {{14}} feels remarkably close to what {{15}} in front of me. Wang Wei found a similar {{16}} in the meeting of autumn and water: "空山新雨后，天气晚来秋" – "After fresh rain on the empty mountains, evening brings the feel of autumn." His poem continues with moonlight among the pines and a clear spring flowing over stones. And although Liangma River is surrounded by one of Beijing's most lively urban districts instead of mountains, the same {{17}} with light moving across water remains. The Liangma River winds through one of Beijing's most {{18}} leisure areas, linking the city's commercial and cultural spaces with a six-kilometer waterfront route of bridges, waterways and riverside scenery. During the day, it offers a quieter view of the city: people {{19}} beside the water, leaves moving overhead and sunlight following the current.
paragraphs.cn: 当我沿着河岸行走时，不禁想起唐代王勃《滕王阁序》中的另一名句：“落霞与孤鹜齐飞，秋水共长天一色”。相隔数个世纪和数千公里，这首诗唤起的意象与我眼前展开的景象惊人地接近。王维在秋与水的相遇中发现了类似的宁静：“空山新雨后，天气晚来秋。”他的诗继续描绘松间明月和清泉石上流。尽管亮马河周围是北京最热闹的城区之一而非山峦，但对光在水面移动的同样迷恋依然存在。亮马河蜿蜒穿过北京最具活力的休闲区之一，以六公里的滨水路线连接城市的商业和文化空间，沿途有桥梁、水道和河畔景色。白天，它提供了城市更安静的视角：人们在水边漫步，树叶在头顶移动，阳光跟随水流。

paragraphs.en: As for the night, the river takes on an entirely different character. The 2026 Beijing Chaoyang International Light Festival's Consumption Season is now underway, with new light-and-shadow experiences along the waterfront launched on September 24. The river's night cruise has also returned, carrying visitors past {{20}} bridges and riverside installations as the lights {{21}} across the water. By day, it is the autumn sky, the turning leaves and the quiet movement of water. By night, the river becomes a {{22}} for light.
paragraphs.cn: 至于夜晚，河流呈现出完全不同的性格。2026北京朝阳国际灯光节消费季现已启动，9月24日沿滨水区推出了新的光影体验。河流夜游也已回归，载着游客经过灯火通明的桥梁和河畔装置，灯光在水面上闪烁。白天，是秋日的天空、变色的树叶和水的静谧流动。夜晚，河流成为光的画布。

paragraphs.en: But in both, there is something that Chinese poets have been writing about for centuries: the {{23}} beauty of a season, captured for a moment where the sky and water {{24}}. Editor's note: Zaruhi Poghosyan is a multimedia editor for CGTN Digital. This article is part of China, Soft Focus – a slow journalism series that offers human-centered glimpses into culture, history and everyday life across China through measured pace and intimate storytelling.
paragraphs.cn: 但在两者中，都有中国诗人几个世纪以来一直在书写的东西：一个季节的短暂之美，在天空与水交汇处被捕捉的瞬间。编者按：Zaruhi Poghosyan是CGTN Digital的多媒体编辑。本文是“中国，柔焦”系列的一部分——一个慢新闻系列，通过从容的节奏和亲密的叙事，提供对中国文化、历史和日常生活的以人为本的瞥见。

articles.fullText:
After Beijing's long, humid summer, autumn arrives almost imperceptibly at first. The air loses some of its weight, the sky opens into clearer blue, and the harsh brightness of summer gives way to a softer, more transparent light. Along the city's avenues and parks, the first yellow leaves begin to appear among the emerald, while the cooler days invite people to reclaim the outdoors – to walk a little farther, sit a little longer and notice the small changes that herald the new season.
For centuries, Chinese poets have found something particular in this transition. "自古逢秋悲寂寥，我言秋日胜春朝" – "Since ancient times, people have lamented autumn's loneliness; I say autumn is better than springtime," wrote Tang Dynasty (AD 618 to 907) poet Liu Yuxi. His words offer a different way of looking at the season – as a time of clarity and renewed life instead of an ending. And perhaps nowhere in the city is that feeling more easily found than beside its waterways.
Along the Liangma River, autumn seems to gather in the afternoon light. Here, sunlight scatters across the ripples, sometimes bright and silver, sometimes softened by the reflections of leaves and sky. The river catches the sky while the yellow-clad willows write their shifting reflections across its surface, and a passing breeze is enough to turn a still image into motion.
As I walk along the riverbank, I cant help but recall another famous Tang Dynasty line, from Wang Bo's Preface to the Pavilion of King Teng: "落霞与孤鹜齐飞，秋水共长天一色" – "The sunset glow flies alongside the solitary wild duck; the autumn waters merge with the vast sky into one color." Centuries and thousands of kilometers away, the image this poem revokes feels remarkably close to what unfolds in front of me.
Wang Wei found a similar stillness in the meeting of autumn and water: "空山新雨后，天气晚来秋" – "After fresh rain on the empty mountains, evening brings the feel of autumn." His poem continues with moonlight among the pines and a clear spring flowing over stones. And although Liangma River is surrounded by one of Beijing's most lively urban districts instead of mountains, the same fascination with light moving across water remains.
The Liangma River winds through one of Beijing's most vibrant leisure areas, linking the city's commercial and cultural spaces with a six-kilometer waterfront route of bridges, waterways and riverside scenery. During the day, it offers a quieter view of the city: people strolling beside the water, leaves moving overhead and sunlight following the current.
As for the night, the river takes on an entirely different character. The 2026 Beijing Chaoyang International Light Festival's Consumption Season is now underway, with new light-and-shadow experiences along the waterfront launched on September 24. The river's night cruise has also returned, carrying visitors past illuminated bridges and riverside installations as the lights shimmer across the water.
By day, it is the autumn sky, the turning leaves and the quiet movement of water. By night, the river becomes a canvas for light. But in both, there is something that Chinese poets have been writing about for centuries: the fleeting beauty of a season, captured for a moment where the sky and water converge.

articles.fullTextCn:
北京漫长潮湿的夏天过后，秋天最初几乎悄无声息地到来。空气不再那么沉重，天空展开为更清澈的蓝色，夏日刺眼的光线让位于更柔和、更透明的光。在城市的大道和公园里，翠绿中开始出现最初的黄叶，而更凉爽的日子邀请人们重新回到户外——多走一段路，多坐一会儿，留意预示着新季节到来的细微变化。几个世纪以来，中国诗人在这转换中发现了某种特别的东西。“自古逢秋悲寂寥，我言秋日胜春朝”——唐代（公元618年至907年）诗人刘禹锡写道。

他的话提供了一种看待这个季节的不同方式——将其视为清晰和重获新生的时刻，而非终结。也许在城市中，没有哪里比水边更容易找到这种感觉。沿着亮马河，秋天似乎聚集在午后的光线中。在这里，阳光散落在涟漪上，时而明亮如银，时而被树叶和天空的倒影柔化。河水映照天空，披着黄衣的柳树在水面写下变幻的倒影，一阵微风就足以将静止的画面变为动态。

当我沿着河岸行走时，不禁想起唐代王勃《滕王阁序》中的另一名句：“落霞与孤鹜齐飞，秋水共长天一色”。相隔数个世纪和数千公里，这首诗唤起的意象与我眼前展开的景象惊人地接近。王维在秋与水的相遇中发现了类似的宁静：“空山新雨后，天气晚来秋。”他的诗继续描绘松间明月和清泉石上流。尽管亮马河周围是北京最热闹的城区之一而非山峦，但对光在水面移动的同样迷恋依然存在。亮马河蜿蜒穿过北京最具活力的休闲区之一，以六公里的滨水路线连接城市的商业和文化空间，沿途有桥梁、水道和河畔景色。白天，它提供了城市更安静的视角：人们在水边漫步，树叶在头顶移动，阳光跟随水流。

至于夜晚，河流呈现出完全不同的性格。2026北京朝阳国际灯光节消费季现已启动，9月24日沿滨水区推出了新的光影体验。河流夜游也已回归，载着游客经过灯火通明的桥梁和河畔装置，灯光在水面上闪烁。白天，是秋日的天空、变色的树叶和水的静谧流动。夜晚，河流成为光的画布。

但在两者中，都有中国诗人几个世纪以来一直在书写的东西：一个季节的短暂之美，在天空与水交汇处被捕捉的瞬间。编者按：Zaruhi Poghosyan是CGTN Digital的多媒体编辑。本文是“中国，柔焦”系列的一部分——一个慢新闻系列，通过从容的节奏和亲密的叙事，提供对中国文化、历史和日常生活的以人为本的瞥见。

articles.fullText:
China's commercial space company launches 10 satellites from the Dongfeng Commercial Space Innovation Test Zone in northwest China on October 14, 2026. /LandSpace
China successfully launched eight satellites for a space-based computing project on Wednesday aboard the Zhuque-2E rocket, developed by the commercial space company LandSpace.
The mission carried 10 satellites in total and lifted off from the Dongfeng Commercial Space Innovation Test Zone in northwest China. The other two satellites were laser-communication test satellites developed by Lanta Intelligence. All 10 satellites entered their planned orbits.
The eight satellites make up the second batch of the space-based computing project dubbed “Xing Suan.” They carry high-performance computing payloads, high-speed laser communication systems linking satellites to one another and to the ground, and low-light cameras.
Developed by the Chinese commercial satellite company ADA Space, the new group will test several key technologies, including a liquid-cooling system at the 10-kilowatt scale, large deployable radiative-cooling wings, a laser communication network, and foundation-model training in orbit.
These tests will help assess how data can be processed in orbit while maintaining reliable computing performance, managing heat, and transferring information efficiently.
Traditionally, large volumes of satellite data are transmitted back to Earth for processing. Onboard computing could enable more data to be analyzed in space before results are sent to the ground, potentially reducing transmission demands and delays while supporting applications in artificial intelligence and remote sensing.
Developed by commercial space company LandSpace, the Zhuque-2E rocket lifts off from the Dongfeng Commercial Space Innovation Test Zone in northwest China on October 14, 2026. /LandSpace
In May 2025, the first group of 12 satellites was launched, marking the initial deployment of the constellation.
In January 2026, the company announced it had deployed Alibaba’s Qwen3 large language model at its first space-based computing center. During tests, questions sent from Earth were processed on the satellites, and the results were returned to ground stations within about two minutes. The company described the achievement as the first deployment of a general-purpose large-scale AI model to an operational satellite constellation in orbit.
While that demonstration involved running AI reasoning tasks in orbit, the newly launched satellites are also set to test foundation-model training in space, thereby expanding the range of computing capabilities being explored.
The development comes as China advances plans for a more integrated computing and communications infrastructure. During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, from 2026 to 2030, China is prioritizing the development of an integrated computing-power network and accelerating the deployment of low-orbit satellite internet. Computing-power and next-generation communications networks are also among the six major infrastructure networks identified for coordinated planning and development.
Space-based computing remains an emerging field, and its broader applications will depend on the reliability and performance of technologies tested in orbit. The latest launch adds another group of satellites to that effort as China explores how computing and AI capabilities could increasingly operate beyond Earth.

articles.fullText:
Palestinian volunteers extinguish an olive tree and a Palestinian-owned vehicle set alight, reportedly by Israeli settlers, near the village of Turmus Ayya, north of Ramallah, in the Israeli-occupied West Bank, October 16, 2026. 
At least 19 Palestinians, including two children aged eight and 12, were injured in attacks by Israeli settlers across the occupied West Bank on Friday, according to the Palestinian Wall and Settlement Resistance Commission.
The commission said in a statement that it documented 34 attacks and violations targeting Palestinian farmers, land and crops across the West Bank that day.
Two foreign journalists were also injured in the clashes. Among them was American photojournalist Heidi Levine, who was hospitalized after being beaten by masked Israeli settlers while covering the olive harvest near Ramallah, according to media reports.
The attacks took place in several areas, including Ramallah, Nablus, Jenin, Tulkarm and Hebron. Settlers, under the protection of Israeli forces, surrounded and beat Palestinian farmers harvesting olives, forced them off their land and detained some of them, the statement said.
The injured included women, elderly people and emergency responders.
The attacks also caused significant property damage. Five Palestinian vehicles were set on fire, including a civil defense rescue vehicle, while several others were vandalized. Numerous olive trees were also burned.
American photojournalist Heidi Levine is transferred on a stretcher into a Palestinian ambulance after being attacked by Israeli settlers while photographing Palestinian farmers harvesting olives in the Palestinian village of Abu Falah, West Bank, October 16, 2026. 
The commission noted that the attacks came during the olive harvest season in the West Bank, a critical period for Palestinian farmers who rely on the crop for their livelihoods. It said repeated settler violence, restrictions on access to farmland and forced displacement had caused substantial economic losses.
The commission called for effective protection for Palestinians and urged that those responsible for the attacks be held accountable.
Israeli authorities have said the incidents are under investigation.
The attacks come amid continued international criticism of Israel's settlement expansion in the occupied West Bank and rising settler violence against Palestinians. In September, UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres warned that settlement expansion was accelerating and undermining the prospects for a viable Palestinian state.
The UN has repeatedly stressed that Israeli settlements in the occupied Palestinian territory violate international law and reaffirmed the two-state solution as the path to lasting peace.

2026年10月16日，在以色列占领的约旦河西岸拉马拉以北的图尔穆斯阿亚村附近，巴勒斯坦志愿者扑灭了一棵被点燃的橄榄树和一辆巴勒斯坦人拥有的车辆，据称是以色列定居者所为。据巴勒斯坦隔离墙与定居点抵抗委员会称，周五在以色列占领的约旦河西岸各地，以色列定居者的袭击造成至少19名巴勒斯坦人受伤，其中包括两名分别为8岁和12岁的儿童。该委员会在一份声明中表示，当天他们记录了34起针对约旦河西岸巴勒斯坦农民、土地和农作物的袭击和侵犯行为。两名外国记者也在冲突中受伤。据媒体报道，其中包括美国摄影记者海蒂·莱文，她在拉马拉附近报道橄榄收获时遭到蒙面以色列定居者殴打后住院治疗。袭击发生在拉马拉、纳布卢斯、杰宁、图勒凯尔姆和希伯伦等多个地区。

声明称，定居者在以色列军队的保护下包围并殴打正在收获橄榄的巴勒斯坦农民，迫使他们离开土地并拘留了部分人。伤者包括妇女、老人和急救人员。袭击还造成了重大财产损失。五辆巴勒斯坦车辆被纵火焚烧，其中包括一辆民防救援车，另有数辆遭到破坏。许多橄榄树也被烧毁。2026年10月16日，美国摄影记者海蒂·莱文在约旦河西岸巴勒斯坦村庄阿布法拉赫拍摄巴勒斯坦农民收获橄榄时遭到以色列定居者袭击，随后被用担架抬上巴勒斯坦救护车。

该委员会指出，袭击发生在约旦河西岸的橄榄收获季节，这对依赖该作物维持生计的巴勒斯坦农民来说是一个关键时期。委员会表示，定居者反复的暴力行为、对农田进入的限制以及强迫流离失所已造成重大经济损失。委员会呼吁为巴勒斯坦人提供有效保护，并敦促追究袭击责任人的责任。以色列当局表示正在调查这些事件。这些袭击发生之际，国际社会持续批评以色列在占领的约旦河西岸扩建定居点以及定居者对巴勒斯坦人暴力行为不断升级。9月，联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯警告称，定居点扩建正在加速，并损害了一个可行的巴勒斯坦国的前景。

联合国一再强调，以色列在占领的巴勒斯坦领土上的定居点违反国际法，并重申两国方案是实现持久和平的途径。

articles.fullText:
Solar panels at a 100-megawatt photovoltaic project supporting a hydrogen energy industrial park in Gaolan County, Lanzhou, northwest China's Gansu Province, June 8, 2026. 
China has approved four-year pilot programs for comprehensive hydrogen energy applications in five city clusters, according to a government circular made public Friday.
The programs will cover the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and three cross-regional groups linking northeast China, including eastern Inner Mongolia, with the Yangtze River Delta, Xinjiang with the Chengdu-Chongqing twin-city economic circle, and the Yellow River bend with the Central Plains.
The circular, jointly released by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Finance and the National Development and Reform Commission, calls on participating cities to accelerate the implementation of four lists of priority tasks covering hydrogen technology and equipment development, industrial hydrogen projects, fuel cell vehicle promotion, and hydrogen refueling station construction.
Cities are also urged to strengthen industrial and supply chains, promote smooth domestic circulation and avoid local protectionism. The circular also calls for better planning of major projects, stronger safety management, and timely assessment of the pilot programs' economic, social and environmental benefits.
The three departments will assess the pilot programs, with the results serving as the basis for allocating central government reward funds. The funds must be disbursed promptly and used only to support hydrogen energy applications, helping lower hydrogen-use costs and pass the savings on to end users, according to the circular.
The initiative comes as China seeks to expand the use of cleaner energy in industry and transport. Hydrogen produced using renewable electricity can help reduce carbon emissions, although high costs and challenges in storage and transportation remain obstacles to wider adoption.
China is already the world's largest producer and consumer of hydrogen, with output exceeding 39 million tonnes in 2025, according to official data.
Under a policy issued in March, China aims to have 100,000 fuel cell vehicles nationwide by 2030, while each city cluster can receive up to 1.6 billion yuan (about $238 million) in central government reward funds over the four-year pilot period.
